messages:
mike: Heads up — seeing a sustained apiserver connection shed in us-west1 starting ~16:15 UTC. controller-manager enters elections, many pods stuck Terminating. GPU backfill pods show FailedAttachVolume and keep retrying. apiserver RSS trending to ~6.5GB and kvcache sweep logs spamming.
anya: link to grafana /logs?
mike: https://grafana.redwood.internal/d/CP/apiserver?view=conn_count — CPU flat but mem climbs. apiserver logs repeatedly show kvcache sweep + compaction messages.
zach: can you paste recent apiserver tail?
mike: ```
# tail -n 40 /var/log/kube-apiserver.log
I0316 16:14:59.123456 1 server.go:123] starting ...
W0316 16:15:03.234567 1 kvcache.go:456] kvcache: sweep duration=350ms objects=12000
E0316 16:15:10.345678 1 watcher.go:89] watch error: context deadline exceeded
E0316 16:20:11.456789 1 server.go:789] runtime: out of memory
panic: runtime: out of memory
goroutine 1 [running]:
... stack ...
```
sre-bot: incident created: INC-2026-314 (auto) — paging oncall
oncall: I'm on it, grabbing controlplane locks. Running: `kubectl get po -n kube-system -o wide`
oncall: ```
NAMESPACE     NAME                                   READY  STATUS   RESTARTS  AGE  NODE
kube-system   kube-apiserver-usw1-0                  1/1    Running  1         2d   cp-node-usw1-1
kube-system   kube-apiserver-usw1-1                  1/1    Running  0         3h   cp-node-usw1-2
kube-system   kube-apiserver-usw1-2                  0/1    CrashLoopBackOff  3  10m  cp-node-usw1-3
kube-system   controller-manager-usw1-0              1/1    Running  0         2d   cp-node-usw1-1
```
anya: any recent controlplane deploy? deploy-bot shows canary for apiserver rolled at 16:12 UTC.
zach: okay, two immediate mitigations: 1) scale kube-apiserver replicas from 3 -> 5 in us-west1, 2) pause noisy workloads that keep creating pods (gpu backfill).
dan: seeing etcd leader CPU + disk latency spike coincident with compaction/snapshot. nvme iops ~90% on cp nodes. suspect etcd fsyncs + kvcache sweeps amplify disk pressure.
mike: that matches: apiserver OOM killed one instance at 16:20, restarted but memory still high. FailedAttachVolume correlates with controller-manager retries while apiserver is struggling to serve node attach requests.
anya: short-term: I'll pause gpu-backfill jobset (gpu-backfill-2026) and route new backfills to eu-west fallback. pausing now.
anya: :thumbsup: paused gpu-backfill-2026 (kubectl scale --replicas=0 job/gpu-backfill-2026)
zach: scaled kube-apiserver replicas -> 5 via `kubectl patch` on controlplane deployment, LB should rebalance. Will also increase controller-manager leader election backoff to reduce thrash.
dan: running etcdctl endpoint status and snapshot now, posting output: ```
# etcdctl --endpoints=https://127.0.0.1:2379 endpoint status
0: name=usw1-cp-0 status=healthy leader=3243db4d rev=1523492 raftTerm=10 hash=0x1a2b
1: name=usw1-cp-1 status=healthy leader=3243db4d rev=1523492 raftTerm=10 hash=0x1a2b
2: name=usw1-cp-2 status=unhealthy
```
mike: good. Dan, can you check WAL size and last compaction time? If compaction is too frequent we should tune `--auto-compaction-retention` and snapshot schedule.
dan: WAL growth high, compaction runs every 5m due to high revision churn from watch-heavy GPU namespace. I'll shift compaction window and throttle watch fanout for gpu namespaces.
infra-bot: Runbook: Control Plane Memory/Throb — https://wiki.redwood/internal/runbooks/controlplane_memory
oncall: paging @zach @anya for visibility. I'll keep monitoring and hold for 1hr.
mike: post-incident actions: 1) limit watch fanout for gpu namespaces, 2) tune etcd compaction schedule and snapshot IO windows, 3) add KVM/Kube-proxy knobs to reduce attach churn, 4) evaluate apiserver memory cap / go runtime flags.
zach: created a temp alert to trigger at apiserver_rss > 5.5GB and etcd_disk_latency > 50ms for quicker detection.
mike: system stabilized after scale + pause. controller-manager retries reduced, FailedAttachVolume stopped. We'll keep this thread open for 1h then close. Please open a postmortem if it recurs.
__note: Slack threads should be a single continuous string in 'messages'.
